identity.name: Rare Binary Connecting to Rare External Host
identity.summary: An attacker downloads a malicious binary from a rare external IP and executes it, creating a network connection to a rare host. Cortex should detect this rare binary and rare external host combination
identity.description: An attacker downloads a malicious binary from a rare external IP and executes it, creating a network connection to a rare host. Cortex should detect this rare binary and rare external host combination.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Binary Connected to Rare External Host
biocs.description: Detection of a rare binary connecting to a rare external host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/malware.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from rare_hosts)
| filter action_file_path in (select file_path from rare_binaries)

abiocs.name: Rare Binary Connecting to Rare External Host
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a rare binary makes a network connection to a rare external host
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from rare_hosts)
| filter actor_process_image_name in (select file_path from rare_binaries)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/malware.exe'

xql_queries.name: Rare Binary to Rare Host Network Connection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in (select remote_ip from rare_hosts)
| filter actor_process_image_name in (select file_path from rare_binaries)
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/malware.exe'
